title.zh-TW: 提問與計畫審核也會跳出終端機通知
title.en: Terminal notifications now fire for questions and plan approvals

body.zh-TW: 開著終端機在背景跑任務，有時 Grok 會停下來等你回答問題或確認下一步。原本權限請求會發送終端機通知，現在提問卡、MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）輸入卡與計畫審核卡也會發出同樣的通知。⟦跟在醫院候診一樣，原本開藥櫃檯會叫號，現在看診和檢查的櫃檯也會按鈴提醒你過去。⟧
body.en: When running tasks in the background in your terminal, Grok sometimes pauses to wait for your answer or confirmation on the next step. Previously, permission requests sent terminal notifications; now question cards, MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) input cards, and plan-approval cards send the same notification. ⟦Think of waiting at a clinic: previously only the pharmacy counter called your number, and now the exam and checkup desks ring a bell to call you over too.⟧

items.original: Question, MCP input, and plan-approval cards now send the same terminal notification as permission requests

title.zh-TW: 用 /resume 可邊打字邊搜尋工作階段內容
title.en: Search session contents as you type with /resume

body.zh-TW: 想接續幾天前的對話卻忘了標題，光看列表往往很難找。現在打開 `/resume` 選擇器後，只要直接打字就會即時搜尋工作階段的對話內容，找到符合的項目就能直接開啟。⟦翻舊筆記本時，以前得一頁頁翻找標題，現在直接按關鍵字查內文，找到那一頁就能立刻接續寫下去。⟧
body.en: When you want to pick up a conversation from a few days ago but forget its title, scanning the list alone can make it hard to find. Now, after opening the `/resume` picker, typing directly searches session conversation contents in real time, and you can open a match right away. ⟦Picture flipping through an old notebook: instead of scanning page by page for a heading, you look up keywords inside the text and immediately pick up writing on that page.⟧

items.original: The `/resume` picker now searches session contents as you type and lets you open a match

title.zh-TW: Skills 內文支援展開傳入的參數變數
title.en: Skills now expand passed argument variables in the body

body.zh-TW: 寫好一段常用的 Skill（可重複呼叫的指令範本）來幫忙檢查檔案，每次卻得換成不同目標。現在只要在 Skill 內文放入 `${ARGUMENTS}` 或 `${ARGUMENTS[N]}`，呼叫時填入的參數就會自動展開並套進內容裡。⟦像寄活動邀請函，以前每封都要手動改人名和時間，現在只要把欄位留空，寄出時就會自動填入對應內容。⟧
body.en: You may have written a handy Skill (a reusable instruction template you can invoke) to help check files, yet each run needs a different target. Now, simply place `${ARGUMENTS}` or `${ARGUMENTS[N]}` in the skill body, and any arguments passed when invoking it will automatically expand into the text. ⟦Sending out event invitations used to mean editing the name and time by hand on every card, whereas now you leave those blanks open and the matching details fill in automatically when sent.⟧

items.original: Skills now expand `${ARGUMENTS}` and `${ARGUMENTS[N]}` in the skill body

title.zh-TW: 子代理達輪次上限會交回成果並喚醒上層代理
title.en: Subagents hitting their turn limit now return work and wake the parent

body.zh-TW: 把繁瑣的任務派給子代理（被派出去分頭處理任務的助手）處理，最怕它做到一半達上限就沒下文。現在子代理一旦達到輪次上限，會先把做到目前的成果交回來，並喚醒派出它的上層代理。⟦請同事幫忙查資料，以前時間到了他沒主動回報就讓你在位子上乾等，現在時間一到他會立刻把整理好的內容交回來叫醒你。⟧
body.en: When you hand a tedious task to a subagent (an assistant dispatched to handle work separately), the worst part is having it hit its limit halfway through with no word back. Now, once a subagent hits its turn limit, it returns the work it has done so far and wakes the parent agent that dispatched it. ⟦Ask a coworker to look up some info: previously, when time ran out without them checking back in, you were left waiting at your desk, whereas now as soon as time is up they hand over what they gathered and wake you up.⟧

items.original: A subagent that hits its turn limit now returns its work and wakes the parent

title.zh-TW: grok inspect 的外掛統計與安全隱藏調整
title.en: Plugin counts and security hiding updates for grok inspect

body.zh-TW:
執行 `grok inspect` 盤點專案設定，現在會把內嵌外掛裡的 hook（特定事件發生時會觸發的小程式）與 MCP 伺服器一併算進統計數量。

在不受信任的資料夾裡執行 `grok inspect`，則會比照一般工作階段，隱藏外掛的 hook 與 LSP 伺服器（提供程式碼提示與檢查的語言服務）。
body.en:
Running `grok inspect` to inventory your project settings now includes hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) and MCP servers from inline plugins in the total count.

When running `grok inspect` inside an untrusted folder, it now hides plugin hooks and LSP servers (language services that provide code hints and checks), matching a regular session.

items.original:
`grok inspect` now counts hooks and MCP servers from inline plugins
`grok inspect` hides plugin hooks and LSP servers in an untrusted folder, matching a session

title.zh-TW: 斜線指令的提示、選取與錯誤回覆調整
title.en: Updates to slash command hints, selection, and error replies

body.zh-TW:
在輸入框敲下 `/` 呼叫內建指令或 Skill，從提示、選取到打錯字都有新反應。

斜線指令的自動補全選單現在會在每個指令名稱後方顯示參數提示。

在斜線選單裡輸入完整的 Skill 名稱，現在能穩定選到完全相符的那一項。

輸入未知或已停用的斜線指令，現在會直接收到回覆，不會被送給模型。
body.en:
Typing `/` in the input box to call a built-in command or Skill now brings new behavior for hints, selection, and typos.

Slash command autocomplete now shows each command's argument hint after its name.

Typing a full Skill name in the slash menu now reliably selects the exact match.

Entering an unknown or disabled slash command now gets a direct reply instead of being sent to the model.

items.original:
Slash command autocomplete now shows each command's argument hint after the name
Typing a full skill name in the slash menu now reliably selects the exact match
Unknown or disabled slash commands now get a direct reply instead of being sent to the model

title.zh-TW: /skills 清單操作與 Skill 名稱顯示改進
title.en: Improvements to /skills list controls and Skill name display

body.zh-TW:
想在對話裡快速叫出特定工具，或看一眼終端機就知道剛剛載入哪一項，這幾個順手度細節都調好了。

在 `/skills` 後面加上名稱，會直接開啟 Skills 分頁並篩選出該名稱。

在 `/skills` 清單裡按下 `Space` 可以摺疊分組，篩選標籤也不再被截斷。

讀取 Skill 時，終端機捲動紀錄與 Shell 標題會顯示它對外宣告的名稱，不再顯示資料夾名稱。

讀取 Skill 的標題在重新載入後，依然會保留這個對外宣告的名稱。
body.en:
To quickly pull up a specific tool in a conversation or tell at a glance in the terminal which one was just loaded, these usability details have been tuned.

Adding a name after `/skills` now opens the Skills tab filtered to that name.

Pressing `Space` in the `/skills` list now folds groups, and the filter label is no longer clipped.

When reading a Skill, the terminal scrollback and shell titles now display its advertised name instead of its folder name.

Skill-read titles keep this advertised name after a reload.

items.original:
`/skills` with a name now opens the Skills tab filtered to that name
Space in the `/skills` list now folds groups, and the filter label is no longer clipped
Skill reads now show the skill's advertised name instead of its folder name in the scrollback and shell titles
Skill-read titles keep the skill's advertised name after a reload

title.zh-TW: 對話進行中的排隊、取消與面板收尾修復
title.en: Fixes for queuing, cancelling, and panel cleanup mid-turn

body.zh-TW:
在 AI 還沒跑完這一輪就先送出後續訊息、排入壓縮或急著按中斷，先前容易出現誤刪或卡住的狀況。

上一輪還在執行就先送出的後續提問，即使那一輪因為達到上限或重複呼叫工具而停下，也不再被丟掉。

一秒內按第二次 `Ctrl+C` 會進入準備離開狀態，不再誤取消下一條排隊中的提問。

前一輪還沒結束時先排進去的 `/compact`，現在能直接按 `Ctrl+C` 取消。

執行 `/rewind` 回退對話，會一併取消還在摘要中的壓縮作業。

停止面板會在它所屬的那一輪對話結束後關閉。
body.en:
Sending a follow-up message, queuing a compaction, or hitting interrupt before the AI finished the current turn previously risked accidental drops or getting stuck.

Follow-ups sent while the previous turn is still running are no longer dropped, even when that turn stops at its cap or on repeated tool calls.

Pressing `Ctrl+C` a second time within one second now arms quit instead of cancelling the next queued prompt.

A `/compact` queued while the previous turn was still running can now be cancelled directly with `Ctrl+C`.

Running `/rewind` to step back the conversation now also cancels a compaction that is still summarizing.

The stop panel now closes after the turn it belongs to finishes.

items.original:
Follow-ups sent into a running turn are no longer dropped when that turn stops at its cap or on repeated tool calls
A second Ctrl+C within one second now arms quit instead of cancelling the next queued prompt
The stop panel now closes when the turn it belongs to finishes
`Ctrl+C` now cancels a `/compact` that was queued while another turn was running
`/rewind` now cancels a compaction that is still summarizing

title.zh-TW: 工作階段標題與歷史預覽顯示修復
title.en: Fixes for session titles and history preview display

body.zh-TW:
翻找過去的對話紀錄或幫工作階段取名字，偶爾會撞見一串看不懂的符號或生不出標題。

工作階段標題不再夾帶原始色彩代碼或控制字元。

重新命名輸入框與歷史預覽畫面也拿掉了原始色彩代碼。

會把推理計算進輸出上限的模型，現在能完成工作階段標題的產生。
body.en:
Browsing past conversation logs or naming a session could occasionally run into gibberish symbols or fail to generate a title.

Session titles no longer include raw color codes or control characters.

The rename input and history previews also strip out raw color codes.

Models that count reasoning against the output limit now finish generating session titles.

items.original:
Session titles no longer show raw color codes or control characters
Rename input and history previews no longer show raw color codes
Session title generation now finishes on models that count reasoning against the output limit

title.zh-TW: 回覆與無頭模式輸出的換行分段更清楚
title.en: Clearer line breaks and paragraphs in replies and headless output

body.zh-TW:
讀 AI 回覆的文字或拿無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）的結果給別的程式接手，段落常黏成一大塊。

在無頭模式下使用 `plain` 或 `json` 格式輸出，呼叫工具之後會自動起新段落。

一般回覆也會保留單一換行符號作為斷行，不再全部併成同一段。
body.en:
When reading AI reply text or passing headless mode (an execution mode with no terminal window) output to another program, paragraphs used to clump into one big block.

When using `plain` or `json` format in headless mode, output now starts a new paragraph after tool calls.

Regular replies also preserve single newlines as line breaks instead of joining everything into one paragraph.

items.original:
Headless plain and json output now start a new paragraph after tool calls
Replies now preserve single newlines as line breaks instead of joining them into one paragraph

title.zh-TW: 單用 --fork-session 改為開新工作階段
title.en: Using --fork-session alone now starts a new session

body.zh-TW: 在終端機啟動 Grok 時，如果只帶了 `--fork-session` 參數，原本會直接失敗。現在單獨使用 `--fork-session` 會開啟一個新的工作階段。
body.en: When starting Grok in the terminal, passing only the `--fork-session` flag previously failed outright. Now using `--fork-session` on its own starts a new session.

items.original: `--fork-session` alone now starts a new session instead of failing

title.zh-TW: 雙擊思考區塊改為選取文字而非收合
title.en: Double-clicking a thinking block selects text instead of collapsing

body.zh-TW: 想複製 AI 思考過程裡的某個字詞，滑鼠連點兩下往往讓整塊內容突然收起來或展開。現在雙擊思考區塊會改為選取文字，不再切換摺疊狀態。
body.en: When trying to copy a word from the AI's thinking process, double-clicking often caused the entire block to suddenly collapse or expand. Double-clicking a thinking block now selects text instead of toggling its collapsed state.

items.original: Double-clicking a thinking block now selects text instead of folding or expanding it

title.zh-TW: Mac 裝有 OrbStack 可啟動限制網路沙盒設定檔
title.en: Network-restricted sandbox profiles start on Mac with OrbStack

body.zh-TW: 同一台電腦上既跑容器工具、又用沙盒（隔離執行環境）的人，先前可能遇過某些沙盒設定檔開不起來。現在 Mac 上就算裝了容器工具 OrbStack，套用限制網路的沙盒設定檔也能正常啟動。
body.en: People running both container tools and a sandbox (an isolated execution environment) on the same computer may have previously seen certain sandbox profiles fail to start. Now, even with the container tool OrbStack installed on a Mac, network-restricted sandbox profiles can start normally.

items.original: Network-restricted sandbox profiles now start on a Mac when OrbStack is installed

title.zh-TW: 修正儀表板派發框對 Enter 鍵動作的標示
title.en: Fix dashboard dispatch box label for Enter key action

body.zh-TW: 在畫面上點選某一列項目準備送出前，以前看旁邊的提示說明可能會被誤導。現在選取儀表板的項目後，派發框會正確標出按下 `Enter` 會執行的動作。
body.en: After selecting a row on screen, the adjacent hint text could previously mislead you as you prepared to submit it. Now, after selecting an item in the dashboard, the dispatch box accurately labels what pressing `Enter` will do.

items.original: Dashboard dispatch box now correctly labels what Enter does when a row is selected

title.zh-TW: 未修改的計畫修訂草稿送出後不再重複出現
title.en: Unchanged plan-revision drafts no longer reappear after sending

body.zh-TW: 送出計畫修訂草稿前如果沒改動任何文字，這份草稿送完還會再度跳回畫面上。這項異常已經修好，未修改的草稿送出後不再重複顯示。
body.en: If no text was edited before sending a plan-revision draft, that draft would pop back onto the screen afterward. This bug is fixed, and unchanged drafts no longer appear again after being sent.

items.original: An unchanged plan-revision draft is no longer shown again after it is sent

title.zh-TW: 點選隱藏的提問卡答案不再誤移游標
title.en: Clicking a hidden question-card answer no longer moves the caret

body.zh-TW: 滑鼠不小心按到畫面上收起來的區塊，打字位置原本會突然跑偏。這個問題已經修好，現在點擊隱藏的提問卡答案不會再移動游標。
body.en: Accidentally clicking a collapsed section on screen previously caused the typing position to jump away. This issue is fixed, and clicking a hidden question-card answer no longer moves the caret.

items.original: Clicks on a hidden question-card answer no longer move the caret

title.zh-TW: 語音聽寫處理上一段期間不再啟動新錄音
title.en: Dictation no longer starts a new recording while processing the last clip

body.zh-TW: 剛講完一句話、畫面還在消化前面那段聲音的空檔，如果不小心再觸發一次收音，以前會直接搶著開錄。這個問題已經修好，現在上一個語音聽寫片段還在處理時不會再啟動新錄音。
body.en: Right after finishing a sentence, while the screen was still processing the previous audio clip, accidentally triggering recording again used to start capturing immediately. This issue is fixed, and dictation no longer starts a new recording while the previous clip is still processing.

items.original: Dictation no longer starts a new recording while the last clip is still processing

title.zh-TW: 修正 grok update 清理舊下載檔時卡住的問題
title.en: Fix grok update hanging while cleaning up old downloads

body.zh-TW: 在終端機跑 `grok update` 更新版本，走到清理舊下載檔案那一步偶爾會停住不動。這個問題已經修好，現在清理舊下載時不會再卡住。
body.en: When running `grok update` in the terminal to update versions, the step that cleans up old downloaded files could occasionally stall. This issue is fixed, and cleaning up old downloads no longer hangs.

items.original: `grok update` no longer hangs while cleaning up old downloads

title.zh-TW: 開啟儀表板後首頁搜尋不再卡在搜尋中
title.en: Home-screen search no longer gets stuck on Searching after opening dashboard

body.zh-TW: 從首頁打開儀表板之後，首頁的工作階段搜尋欄原本會一直停在「Searching」狀態。這個問題已經修好，現在搜尋狀態不會再卡在搜尋中。
body.en: After opening the dashboard from the home screen, the home-screen session search bar previously stayed stuck in the "Searching" state. This issue is fixed, and the search status no longer gets stuck on Searching.

items.original: Home-screen session search no longer sticks on Searching after the dashboard opens

title.zh-TW: 工作階段還原失敗的分頁改為拒收新提問
title.en: Tabs with failed session restores now refuse new prompts

body.zh-TW: 重開程式後，如果某個視窗沒能成功接回先前的對話，你在裡面打字送出的訊息原本會像石沉大海一樣消失。現在遇到這種工作階段還原失敗的分頁，會改為明確拒收這則提問，不再默默丟棄。
body.en: After restarting the app, if a window failed to reconnect to its previous conversation, any message you typed and sent there used to vanish without a trace. Now, on a tab whose session failed to restore, the new prompt is explicitly refused rather than silently dropped.

items.original: A prompt typed on a tab whose session failed to restore is now refused instead of dropped

title.zh-TW: 工具搜尋列改為以 Search 開頭顯示
title.en: Tool search rows now start with Search

body.zh-TW: 在對話紀錄裡看到 AI 正在翻找資料時，找檔案跟找外部功能的提示行以前長得不太一致。現在工具搜尋列也改為以 `Search` 開頭，與檔案搜尋列保持相同格式。
body.en: When you see the AI looking up information in the conversation history, the lines for finding files and finding external features used to look inconsistent. Now tool search rows also start with `Search`, keeping the same format as file-search rows.

items.original: Tool search rows now start with Search, matching file-search rows

title.zh-TW: 修正 tmux 中 Grok 窗格的重繪問題
title.en: Fix Grok pane repainting issues in tmux

body.zh-TW: 用 tmux（把終端機分成多個窗格的工具）分割畫面來跑 Grok，以前按某些順序調整大小後，畫面會沒辦法正常更新。現在這些操作順序下，窗格都能正確重繪了。
body.en: When running Grok in a split screen using tmux (a tool that splits a terminal into multiple panes), the display previously failed to update properly after resizing in certain sequences. Now the panes repaint correctly under those operation sequences.

items.original: Grok panes in tmux now repaint correctly after certain resize sequences
